title: Wasmtime before 36.0.18, 37.0.0 before 48.0.6, and 49.0.0 before 49.0.3 caps component-model resource handle tables…
description: A vulnerability in Wasmtime before versions 36.0.18, 48.0.6, and 49.0.3 allows unbounded host memory growth. The issue arises because resource handle tables are capped only per component instance and do not account for allocations charged to any ResourceLimiter or StoreLimits. This enables a malicious guest to repeatedly allocate resources and instantiate sub-components, bypassing intended limits.
